name: Tuodao Medical
description: Tuodao Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (佗道医疗) is a surgical robotics company based in Nanjing, China. Founded in 2019 out of the 'Robot X Lab' research incubator founded by Dr. Cheng Min and supported by the Yijiahe ecosystem, the company develops robotic surgical systems across laparoscopy, orthopedics, percutaneous intervention, and natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery.
